camel_example: aliyun ndr UpdateProtoLogDeliveryStatus --region cn-hangzhou --StatusList.1.Site global --StatusList.1.AttackLogStatus 1 --StatusList.1.DeliveryType sls --StatusList.1.ProtoLogStatus 1 --DeliveryType sls --version 2024-01-24 --method POST --force
description_en: Updates the log delivery switches for protocol logs and attack logs of specified sites in batches. For each site in StatusList, both switches must be explicitly specified, where 0 indicates shutdown and 1 indicates enabled. If either switch is omitted, the API returns InvalidParam and no sites are updated in the current request. To modify only one type of switch, invoke DescribeProtoLogDeliveryStatus to query the current status first, and then pass the current value of the other switch
description_zh: 批量更新指定站点的协议日志和攻击日志投递开关。StatusList 中的每个站点都须显式传入两类开关，0 表示关闭，1 表示开启。省略任一开关时，接口返回 InvalidParam，本次请求不会更新任何站点。只修改一类开关时，可先调用 DescribeProtoLogDeliveryStatus 查询当前状态，再将另一类开关的当前值一并传入
kebab_example: aliyun ndr update-proto-log-delivery-status --delivery-type sls --status-list Site=global AttackLogStatus=1 ProtoLogStatus=1 DeliveryType=sls --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateProtoLogDeliveryStatus

parameters.help_en: The compatibility parameter. Valid value: sls. The current update is subject to the DeliveryType of each item in StatusList. Passing only this parameter does not update the switches
parameters.help_zh: 兼容参数，取值为 sls。当前更新以 StatusList 中各项的 DeliveryType 为准，仅传入本参数不会更新开关
parameters.name: delivery_type

fields.help_en: The log delivery switch for attack logs. This parameter must be explicitly specified. A value of 0 indicates shutdown, and a value of 1 indicates enabled. If this parameter is omitted, the API returns InvalidParam. To retain the current status, pass the current value returned by DescribeProtoLogDeliveryStatus
fields.help_zh: 攻击日志投递开关，须显式传入。0 表示关闭，1 表示开启。省略时返回 InvalidParam。如需保留当前状态，请传入 DescribeProtoLogDeliveryStatus 返回的当前值
fields.name: attack_log_status

fields.help_en: The delivery type. You must specify sls for each site
fields.help_zh: 投递类型，每个站点均须传入 sls
fields.name: delivery_type

fields.help_en: The log delivery switch for protocol logs. This parameter must be explicitly specified. A value of 0 indicates shutdown, and a value of 1 indicates enabled. If this parameter is omitted, the API returns InvalidParam. To retain the current status, pass the current value returned by DescribeProtoLogDeliveryStatus
fields.help_zh: 协议日志投递开关，须显式传入。0 表示关闭，1 表示开启。省略时返回 InvalidParam。如需保留当前状态，请传入 DescribeProtoLogDeliveryStatus 返回的当前值
fields.name: proto_log_status

fields.help_en: The identifier of the site to be updated. This parameter cannot be empty. Use the site returned by DescribeProtoLogDeliveryStatus
fields.help_zh: 待更新的站点标识，不能为空。使用 DescribeProtoLogDeliveryStatus 返回的站点
fields.name: site

parameters.help_en: The list of switch configurations for the sites to be updated. This parameter cannot be empty. Each item must include DeliveryType, Site, ProtoLogStatus, and AttackLogStatus. The system updates only the sites in the list and writes both switches for each site simultaneously. If any site is missing either switch, the API returns InvalidParam and no sites are updated in the current request
parameters.help_zh: 待更新站点的开关配置列表，不能为空。每项须传入 DeliveryType、Site、ProtoLogStatus 和 AttackLogStatus。系统只更新列表中的站点，并同时写入每个站点的两个开关。任一站点缺少任一开关时，接口返回 InvalidParam，本次请求不会更新任何站点
parameters.name: status_list

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned when the request fails. This parameter is empty when the request succeeds. The example shows a failure scenario
ErrorCode.description_zh: 请求失败时的错误码；请求成功时为空。示例展示失败场景

Message.description_en: The message about the request result. This parameter describes the cause of the error when the request fails. The example shows a parameter validation failure scenario
Message.description_zh: 请求结果信息；失败时用于说明错误原因。示例展示参数校验失败场景

RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于定位本次请求

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful. A value of true indicates success, and a value of false indicates failure
Success.description_zh: 请求是否成功。true 表示成功，false 表示失败
